title: allostelites arvensis
intro: Allostelites arvensis, commonly known as Silver Ragwort, is a type of flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is often used to treat digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Allostelites arvensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
